about: Every generated piece of art the app uses. The field guide's shot list, as data. `source: generate` pieces are made with Art/generate.py; `source: drawn` pieces are hand-written SVG and never cost credits. `cutout: true` means make-art removes the background.
background: Isolated on a plain, flat, uniform pale grey (#eef0f3) background with nothing else in the frame.

assets.name: cast-director
assets.brief: An emblem: a single mixing-desk channel strip seen head-on — one long fader, a pan knob above it, and one lit solo key in step-key orange. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-beatmaker
assets.where: Band rail, Compare candidates it made
assets.brief: An emblem: a 4 by 4 grid of square drum pads in 3/4 isometric view, two pads lit in step-key orange, a row of small swing tick marks along one edge. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-sampler
assets.where: Band rail, chops and dust it made
assets.brief: An emblem: eight slim vertical faders in a row at different heights, with a single audio waveform line drawn across their caps. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-critic
assets.where: Check surface, refusals in the rail
assets.brief: An emblem: an analogue VU meter with its needle resting in a small red zone at the right of the scale. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-you
assets.where: Band rail, 'made by you' in provenance
assets.brief: An emblem: a single confident hand-drawn waveform stroke in signal blue, loose and human, with no machine around it. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-bassist
assets.brief: An emblem: a four-string bass guitar headstock seen side-on, tuning pegs drawn precisely, strings as hairlines. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: app-icon-concepts
assets.where: Exploration only; the final icon is redrawn in Icon Composer
assets.brief: A macOS app icon concept for a music app called Mr. Roboto: the front panel of a drum machine whose sixteen step keys are arranged to read as a friendly robot face — two lit orange keys for eyes, a row for a mouth. Rounded-square icon shape, graphite body.

assets.name: doc-icon
assets.brief: A document page icon with a thin waveform strip across its top and a single orange step key at its lower corner.

assets.name: machine-sp1200
assets.brief: A generic 1987 sampling drum machine seen in 3/4 view: a wide warm-grey body, eight slim faders, a small two-line display, a grid of rubber buttons. No brand name or logo anywhere.

assets.name: machine-mpc60
assets.brief: A generic late-1980s grey music production workstation in 3/4 view with a 4 by 4 block of square pads and a large LCD screen. No brand name or logo anywhere.

assets.name: machine-cassette
assets.brief: A cassette tape seen head-on through the window of a tape deck, reels partly wound, tape visible between them.

assets.name: machine-vinyl
assets.brief: A turntable seen from above: platter, a record with fine grooves, the tonearm resting on the record.

assets.name: machine-radio
assets.brief: A 1960s transistor radio in 3/4 view with a round perforated speaker grille and a tuning dial.

assets.name: empty-first-launch
assets.brief: A vinyl record sliding into the front of a drum machine and emerging from the back as a row of lit orange step keys. Side view, left to right.

assets.name: empty-drop-record
assets.brief: A vinyl record hovering above an open slot shaped like an audio waveform, the slot drawn with a dashed outline.

assets.name: wait-separating
assets.brief: One audio waveform on the left splitting into four parallel lanes on the right, like cables fanning out of a patch bay.

assets.name: empty-grid
assets.brief: A row of sixteen unlit drum-machine step keys in four colour groups — red-orange, orange, yellow, cream — one key pressed halfway down.

assets.name: wait-band
assets.brief: A mixing-desk channel strip with two small instrument emblems — a pad grid and a fader bank — patched into it by curving cables.

assets.name: empty-library
assets.brief: An empty wooden-slat record crate seen from above at an angle.

assets.name: band-record
assets.brief: A very wide, very faint horizontal strip: one long audio waveform with section brackets along its top. Very low contrast.

assets.name: band-chop
assets.brief: A very wide, very faint horizontal strip: an audio waveform crossed by evenly spaced vertical cut lines, a tiny square pad under each cut. Very low contrast.

assets.name: band-grid
assets.brief: A very wide, very faint horizontal strip: a long row of drum-machine step keys in four faded colour groups. Very low contrast.

assets.name: band-sound
assets.brief: A very wide, very faint horizontal strip: a row of knobs above a thin circuit trace. Very low contrast.

assets.name: glyphs
assets.where: Path strip, Parts groups, crumbs, library
assets.brief: Record, four stems, chop, groove, feel, dust, sound, section, song, album, version, idea, seed, compare, check.

assets.name: wordmark
assets.brief: Mr. Roboto in IBM Plex Sans SemiBold, the full stop drawn as a lit orange step key.

assets.name: cast-producer
assets.where: M4: the Cast surface, the rail
assets.brief: An emblem: a producer's talkback microphone on a short desk stand, one small red button on its base, drawn with a few precise lines. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-engineer
assets.where: M4: the Cast surface, the rail
assets.brief: An emblem: a single channel strip of a mixing console seen from above — a long fader at the bottom, four small knobs above it, one peak light. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-peer
assets.where: M4: the Cast surface, the rail
assets.brief: An emblem: a pair of over-ear headphones hung on a hook, cable looping once, drawn precisely with a few lines. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-lyricist
assets.where: M4: the Cast surface, the rail
assets.brief: An emblem: a fountain pen laid across a small open notebook with three short ruled lines and one word crossed out, drawn with a few precise lines. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-harmonist
assets.brief: An emblem: a short fragment of a piano keyboard seen in three-quarter view, six white keys and the black keys between them, with three keys pressed down together as a chord. The pressed keys sit visibly lower than the rest. Compact, fits inside a circle.

assets.name: cast-melodist
assets.brief: An emblem: a music-box cylinder seen side-on, a short metal drum on two end bearings with small pins standing out of it, the pins arranged in a line that rises and then falls. Compact, fits inside a circle.
